card.summary: 'MorphoSource is able to subsidize or support free contribution of data for most users with 100GB or less.' 100 GB–1 TB is case-by-case (may be fully free); ...

free_tier.stated: 'MorphoSource is able to subsidize or support free contribution of data for most users with 100GB or less.' 100 GB–1 TB is case-by-case (may be fully free); >1 TB is $3.47/GB + $30.

egress.terms: 'users are never charged for data consumption. Whether that means viewing or downloading data, there are no costs associated with using data.'

record.tooling: Web upload + batch submission tooling (Duke wiki 'Batch Submission'); no public upload API. Read side serves media files over HTTPS per-record.
record.chaining: Per-user total contribution is tracked ('these data size limits apply to the total contribution of data by a user or institution'), so 100 GB is per identity, not per record. Multiple contributor identities multiply it. Read side free regardless.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: none published; the binding cap is a per-identity total of 100 GB free (100 GB–1 TB discretionary). Retention: 'retain all data .. for as long as MorphoSource continues to exist'. No expiry but no endowment either. Contributor status is application-gated.
record.reliability_note: Funding-dependent: the docs themselves state the free 100 GB subsidy is time-limited and will likely fall to ~15 GB within 2–5 years. Treat the current number as decaying.

evidence.proved: 100 GB free, 1 TB discretionary, $3.47/GB above, 'likely around 15GB' future model
